title: How to install stone veneer on a fireplace? - GenStone
text:
How to install stone veneer on a fireplace?

Fireplace installs depend on the surface, clearance requirements, and whether the area is heat-adjacent. Plan your layout, keep everything level, use the correct fastening or adhesive method for the surface, and finish edges and transitions cleanly. For any heat exposure, confirm the veneer system and clearances are appropriate for your installation.
